scope: Reviewed six-problem profile; full corpus enrollment is separate from profile qualification; no automatic semantic role inference

countLowercase.contract: 26 counts indexed a..z; lowercase ASCII precondition; fresh list; no input mutation

lowerBound.contract: First index whose value >= target in sorted nondecreasing values; len when absent; half-open interval [left_index,right_index); no mutation

countBoundedValues.contract: Dense exact counts at value-minimum; inclusive finite declared value bounds; fresh list; no mutation

splitRun.contract: Sever after at most run_length nodes; return remaining head; rewires next; run_length>=1

mergeRuns.contract: Stable ascending merge of disjoint finite sorted lists; return [head,tail]; reuses input nodes; null tail only if both empty

sortLinkedList.contract: Bottom-up stable merges; returned nodes are exactly original input nodes; no value mutation

findRotatedMinimum.contract: Minimum of nonempty rotated strictly ascending values; half-open candidate interval; no mutation

areAnagrams.contract: Equal lowercase ASCII character multisets; no mutation

longestIncreasingLength.contract: Strictly increasing subsequence length; lower_bound replaces equal tails; no input mutation

topFrequentValues.contract: Distinct result_count highest-frequency integers; unique cutoff required; any result order; fresh output; bounded values -10000..10000

firstUniqueIndex.contract: First zero-based lowercase ASCII character position with count1, else -1; no mutation

external_interface: Exact pinned Solution method and argument order retained. Thin single-return adapter to registered internal function. Free functions are legacy harness inputs only.
role_authority: Reviewer supplies a complete source-hash-bound mapping from AST/scope binding IDs to semantic roles. Syntax never infers meaning. Unknown mappings require review, not automatic renaming.
mechanical: exact external signature and forwarding adapter
registered helper signatures and positional arity
reviewer_dependent: helper body conforms to its declared contract
exceptions: Public LeetCode parameter and method spellings and Python self are explicit fixed-interface exceptions; language-specific control variables and tuple destructuring are permitted via reviewed roles. Other exceptions need a named reviewed policy version; no unbounded ignore rule.

formatters.javascript: installed Babel parser/generator, multiline blocks, two spaces; comments preserved
formatters.python: Python3 ast.unparse, four spaces; comments must be separately reviewed/preserved before formatting

indentation: automatic formatting consumes zero semantic macro vocabulary slots
macro_budget: Whole-solution macros remain allowed within256; this standard does not choose a vocabulary or require shared runtime dependencies

heap_convention_not_piloted.contract: Negative comparator means higher priority; explicit comparator and deterministic tie rule; mutate only the heap array; pop on empty raises; signature/body support requires a later reviewed policy extension.
